title: Ticket-Bench: A Kickoff for Multilingual and Regionalized Agent Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing LLM function-calling accuracy and consistency (using a pass^3 metric) across six major languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, Italian, and French) in a simulated task-oriented environment.

Instantiating culturally grounded evaluation environments with region-specific entities—including localized user names, national soccer leagues, team names, and cities—to assess model performance and adaptability across different geographic and cultural contexts.
